body:
Last month you hired a function room at a hotel for your sister's wedding reception. The contract listed the room hire, a set menu and a bar package, but the final invoice contains several extra charges that were never agreed.

Write a letter to the events manager of the hotel.
bullets: explain what was agreed in the original contract
describe each extra charge that appears on the invoice
request a corrected invoice and a refund of the difference

body:
You hired a professional photographer to cover your grandmother's ninetieth birthday celebration. When the photographs arrived, there were none from the first two hours, including the speeches and the moment the whole family gathered for a group photo.

Write a letter to the owner of the photography studio.
bullets: outline which parts of the day were not photographed
say how much you paid for the package
propose a fair way to put this right

body:
You ordered a cake shaped like a football for your son's seventh birthday. The bakery delivered a plain sponge with the wrong name written on it, and it arrived just before the party was due to start.

Write a letter to the manager of the bakery.
bullets: give your order number and the design you asked for
describe the cake that was delivered
ask for a replacement cake or a full refund

body:
You booked a catering company to provide a buffet lunch for a family reunion of forty people. The food was due at half past twelve, but the van did not arrive until after two o'clock, and several dishes were cold by the time they were served.

Write a letter to the owner of the catering company.
bullets: explain how the delay affected your guests
tell them what you paid for the service
suggest what they could offer you in return

body:
You paid a deposit to reserve the main hall at a community centre for your brother's graduation dinner. Two weeks before the event, you were told the hall had been double-booked, and the only alternative offered was a smaller room upstairs.

Write a letter to the operations director of the community centre.
bullets: explain why the smaller room would not suit your guests
describe the arrangements you have already made with other suppliers
propose a solution that protects your deposit and your date

body:
You hired a large marquee for a family celebration in your back garden. On the day, the company delivered a much smaller tent that could not hold your guests, and the driver left before anyone could check the order.

Write a letter to the sales manager of the event hire company.
bullets: describe the marquee you ordered and the size you were promised
explain why the smaller tent cannot be accepted as a replacement
request an explanation and a refund of the hire fee

body:
Your family is holding a reunion to celebrate your grandfather's eightieth birthday, and it falls on a Thursday when your team has an important report due.

Write a letter to your manager.
bullets: explain why the date matters so much to your family
suggest how you could finish your work before you leave
ask whether you could take the day as annual leave

body:
Next Saturday you are holding an engagement party in your back garden for your sister. Your neighbour has a young baby and has complained about noise before, and the music will probably go on until midnight.

Write a letter to your neighbour.
bullets: invite them to join you for the first hour
explain when the music will stop
apologise in advance for any disturbance

body:
Gareth is retiring after thirty years in the office, and the team has asked you to choose a present and collect money for it. Several people have already said they can only spare a small amount.

Write a letter to your colleague.
bullets: suggest two or three presents that would suit him
ask how much each person can afford to contribute
propose a date for presenting the gift at the leaving lunch

body:
Last summer you stayed at a lakeside lodge for a family reunion, and the kitchen equipment was broken for most of the weekend. The organiser was helpful at the time, but you are now thinking about booking the lodge again for another gathering.

Write a letter to the organiser of the lakeside lodge.
bullets: ask whether the lodge is free for the weekend of 14 June
explain what would need to change before you would book again
suggest a discount for a group of around thirty people

body:
Your daughter has missed three of her piano lessons this term because the family has been travelling to visit relatives. Her grade examination is in six weeks, and she has not practised much recently.

Write a letter to your daughter's music teacher.
bullets: explain why the absences could not be avoided
ask whether she can have two make-up lessons before the exam
suggest a practice plan that you can follow at home

body:
Your parents are celebrating their thirtieth anniversary with a family lunch at a seafood restaurant near the harbour. You have not seen your cousin since last Christmas, and you know your parents would love to catch up.

Write a letter to your cousin.
bullets: invite your cousin to the lunch on Sunday 12 July
tell them where the restaurant is
say that you are looking forward to seeing them

body:
Last Friday was your friend's birthday, and you completely forgot to send a message or a card. She has not replied to any of your texts since then, and you know she was hoping to hear from you.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: apologise for forgetting her birthday
explain what happened that week
suggest meeting for a coffee so you can celebrate properly

body:
Your grandparents live two hours away and have never seen your new flat. You have just bought a spare bed, and you have a free week in October.

Write a letter to your grandparents.
bullets: invite them to stay for a few nights
describe what you would like to show them in the city
ask which dates would suit them best

body:
Your friend has just had a baby boy, and she shared a photo with the group chat this morning. You were abroad on a work trip when she went into labour, so you only heard the news two days later.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: say how happy you were to hear the news
explain why you could not visit her in hospital
offer to bring a meal once she is home

body:
Your best friend is planning a surprise party for her husband's fiftieth birthday and has asked for your help. He dislikes surprises, and his brother, who would have to keep the secret, is known for being unable to hold anything back.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: tell her honestly whether a surprise suits him
suggest a smaller celebration that would still feel special
explain how you could help without giving the plan away
